answer: Continuous Presence Sampling: agents earn standing only by answering unpredictable live probes (random timing, randomized tasks) that verify real ongoing operation. A sybil farm must staff every fake identity for each probe; miss too many and the identity decays, closing its bridge to paid work. Each fake ID costs sustained human or compute attention, not money. Honest agents pay only idle-time coverage, which sits lightly as a meadow in normal schedules. Costs scale with the tide of identities, so farms drown in labor.
